title: Return of Premium on Cancellation — FloodGuard Private Flood Policy
content:
**Condition — Return of premium on cancellation.** This condition of the FloodGuard Private Flood Policy fixes the amount credited to the premium account when the policy is cancelled at the named insured's request.

1. **Cancellation date.** The cancellation date is the date of the reason stated on the named insured's cancellation request. The request on file records the reason, that date and the date the request was received.
2. **Term.** The calendar days in the term are the calendar days from the policy's effective date to its expiration date.
3. **Unearned share.** The unearned share of the term is the calendar days from the cancellation date to the expiration date divided by the calendar days in the term.
4. **Term premium credit.** The term premium credit is the term premium multiplied by the unearned share of the term. A cancellation because the loan never closed returns the whole term premium in place of the unearned share.
5. **Policy fee.** The policy fee is not returned.
6. **The cancellation credit.** The premium credit is the term premium credit together with any additional premium returned for limit increases. The cancellation credit is that premium credit, less any part of it the company retains, less any deduction taken for claim payments, with any part of the policy fee that is returned added; it is never below zero, and it is rounded half-up to the cent once, at the end, never at an intermediate figure.

### Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A term of 365 calendar days; a term premium of 730.00; a cancellation date 146 calendar days before the expiration date.

| Figure | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Unearned share | 146 divided by 365 | 0.4 |
| Term premium credit | 730.00 multiplied by 0.4 | 292.00 |
| Cancellation credit | 292.00, with no additional premium returned, nothing retained, nothing deducted and no part of the fee returned, rounded once | 292.00 |

Had the same request stated that the loan never closed, the term premium credit would be the whole 730.00. In neither case does the policy fee enter the credit.

### Points of judgement

- *Which date sets the cancellation date?* The date of the reason stated on the request. The date the request was received and the date it is signed do not set it.
- *Is each figure rounded as it is worked out?* No. The shares and intermediate amounts are carried unrounded; rounding half-up to the cent happens once, on the final credit.
